Name: SWORDARTS_TABLE_PARAM_ST
Description: Weighted skill tables used by weapon rolls; the weapon's current skill is excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Standard row header flag: set rows are left out of the network test build. Appears unused by the game. Retail: set on every row.

Fields.Name: Skill
Fields.Description: Skill (SwordArtsParam) this row can roll. A reroll skips the row holding the weapon's current skill.

Fields.Name: Roll Weight
Fields.Description: Weight of this row in the roll, against the sum of the table's rows. 0: never rolled. Retail: 100, 50 on a few.
